<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es-CL">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0,
user-scalable=no" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0f172a" />
<title>ConcursoPro</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json" />
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="icon.svg" />
<style>
:root {
--bg: #0f172a;
--surface: #1e293b;
--surface-2: #273549;
--border: #334155;
--text: #f8fafc;
--muted: #94a3b8;
--primary: #10b981;
--gold: #f59e0b;
--gold-soft: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
--danger: #ef4444;
--info: #38bdf8;
--radius: 14px;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
body {
margin: 0;
font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
background: var(--bg);
color: var(--text);
padding-bottom: 84px;
line-height: 1.4;
}
.topbar {
position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30;
background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94);
backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
padding: 12px 16px;
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
.brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.brand-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-
overflow: ellipsis; }
.brand-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.stats-pill {
background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); white-space: nowrap;
}
.backup-banner {
background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.16);
border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
color: #fde68a; padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 13px;
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
.backup-banner button {
background: var(--gold); color: #111827; border: none; border-radius: 8px;
padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;
}
.container { padding: 14px; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; }
.tab-panel { display: none; }
.tab-panel.active { display: block; }
.card {
background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.card-title {
font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 10px 0;
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
label {
display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted);
margin-bottom: 5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}
input, textarea, select {
width: 100%; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
padding: 11px 12px; font-size: 15px; font-family: inherit; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
input:focus, textarea:focus, select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); }
.row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.row > * { flex: 1; }
.btn {
width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 11px; padding: 13px 14px;
font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer;
display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
transition: transform 0.08s ease;
}
.btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
.btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: #052e16; }
.btn-gold { background: var(--gold); color: #1f1300; }
.btn-info { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16); color: #7dd3fc; border: 1px solid rgba(56,
189, 248, 0.4); }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--
border); }
.btn-danger { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.16); color: #fca5a5; border: 1px solid rgba(239,
68, 68, 0.35); }
.btn-sm { padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 8px; width: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.packs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom:
12px; }
.pack-btn {
background: var(--bg); border: 2px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
padding: 10px 6px; color: var(--text); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; position: relative;
}
.pack-btn.selected { border-color: var(--primary); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); }
.pack-btn.featured { border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6); }
.pack-btn.featured.selected { border-color: var(--gold); background: var(--gold-soft); }
.pack-badge {
position: absolute; top: -9px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
background: var(--gold); color: #111827; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900;
padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap;
}
.pack-qty { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; display: block; margin-top: 2px; }
.pack-price { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); display: block; }
.pack-unit { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
.hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: -6px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.hint.warn { color: #fbbf24; }
.hint.ok { color: var(--primary); }
.returning-box {
background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 12px;
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #bae6fd;
}
.list-item {
background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px;
padding: 11px; margin-bottom: 8px;
display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
.item-main { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.item-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-word; }
.item-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.code-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 6px; }
.chip {
font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--surface-2);
border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 6px; color: #e2e8f0;
}
.chip.winner { background: var(--gold-soft); border-color: var(--gold); color: #fde68a; }
.theme-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom:
12px; }
.theme-opt {
border: 2px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px; padding: 10px;
background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer;
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
}
.theme-opt.active { border-color: var(--primary); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); }
.swatch { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #fff; flex-shrink: 0; }
.logo-preview-wrap {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
background: var(--bg); padding: 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.logo-preview-wrap img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 8px;
background: #020617; }
.bottom-nav {
position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 40;
background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
padding: 6px 6px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
.nav-btn {
background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
padding: 6px 4px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
align-items: center; gap: 3px; cursor: pointer;
}
.nav-btn span.ico { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; }
.nav-btn.active { color: var(--primary); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); }
.modal-backdrop {
position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.88);
display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px;
}
.modal-backdrop.open { display: flex; }
.modal {
background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
width: 100%; max-width: 460px; max-height: 92vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px;
}
.ticket-preview { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); display:
block; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.modal-pill {
background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
color: #6ee7b7; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px;
font-weight: 700; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
/* Modo Sorteo Live */
.live-stage {
background: radial-gradient(circle at top, #1e293b 0%, #090d16 80%);
border: 2px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px 16px;
text-align: center; margin-bottom: 14px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.live-stage.sim-mode { border-color: var(--info); }
.sim-ribbon {
background: var(--info); color: #082f49; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900;
padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
body.live-fullscreen .topbar,
body.live-fullscreen .backup-banner,
body.live-fullscreen .bottom-nav,
body.live-fullscreen .hide-in-live { display: none !important; }
body.live-fullscreen { padding-bottom: 16px; background: #050811; }
body.live-fullscreen .live-stage { min-height: 86vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-
content: center; }
.live-badge {
display: inline-block; background: var(--gold-soft); border: 1px solid var(--gold);
color: #fde68a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
}
.live-prize-name { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; margin: 12px 0 18px; color: #fff; }
.roulette-box {
background: #020617; border: 2px solid #334155; border-radius: 14px;
padding: 22px 10px; margin-bottom: 18px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
}
.roulette-code {
font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
font-size: 36px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--gold);
}
.roulette-winner { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); margin-top: 8px; min-
height: 28px; }
.roulette-rut { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); min-height: 20px; }
.scanner-video {
width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; background: #000;
aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--primary);
}
#confettiCanvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 100; display: none; }
.toast {
position: fixed; top: 70px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 120;
background: #059669; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 999px;
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
display: none; white-space: nowrap;
}
.kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.kpi { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
padding: 10px; text-align: center; }
.kpi-val { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--text); }
.kpi-lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
.hidden { display: none !important; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="confettiCanvas"></canvas>
<div id="toast" class="toast"></div>
<header class="topbar">
<div class="brand">
<div class="brand-title" id="hdrContestName">Cargando...</div>
<div class="brand-sub" id="hdrContestDate"></div>
</div>
<div class="stats-pill" id="hdrRevenue">$0</div>
</header>
<div id="backupBanner" class="backup-banner hidden">
<span id="backupBannerText"> Cambios sin respaldar</span>
<button onclick="exportContestJson()">Respaldar</button>
</div>
<main class="container">
<!-- TAB 1: VENDER -->
<section id="tab-sell" class="tab-panel active">
<div class="kpi-grid">
<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-val" id="kpiSales">0</div><div class="kpi-
lbl">Ventas</div></div>
<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-val" id="kpiTickets">0</div><div class="kpi-
lbl">Tickets</div></div>
<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-val" id="kpiPrizes">0</div><div class="kpi-
lbl">Premios</div></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title">
<span>⚡ Nueva Venta</span>
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="copySalesTemplate()"> Plantilla
WA</button>
</div>
<details style="margin-bottom:12px;">
<summary style="cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#38bdf8;margin-
bottom:8px;">
 Pegado rápido desde WhatsApp (toca aquí)
</summary>
<textarea id="quickPasteBox" rows="3" placeholder="Pega aquí el mensaje del
comprador (Nombre, RUT, Pack)..."></textarea>
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" style="width:100%;"
onclick="applyQuickPaste()">Rellenar campos automáticamente</button>
</details>
<label>Elige el Pack</label>
<div class="packs-grid" id="packsContainer"></div>
<label for="buyerName">Nombre completo</label>
<input id="buyerName" type="text" placeholder="Ej: Camila Rojas" autocomplete="off" />
<div class="row">
<div>
<label for="buyerRut">RUT</label>
<input id="buyerRut" type="text" placeholder="18.456.789-2" oninput="onRutInput()"
autocomplete="off" />
</div>
<div>
<label for="buyerPhone">WhatsApp</label>
<input id="buyerPhone" type="tel" placeholder="+56912345678" autocomplete="off" />
</div>
</div>
<div id="rutHint" class="hint">Verifica el abono real en tu banco antes de emitir.</div>
<div id="returningCustomerBox" class="returning-box hidden"></div>
<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="createSale()"> Confirmar pago y generar
ticket</button>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title">
<span> Ventas recientes</span>
<span id="salesCountBadge" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);">0</span>
</div>
<input id="salesSearch" type="text" placeholder="Buscar por nombre, RUT, ID o código..."
oninput="renderSalesList()" />
<div id="salesList"></div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- TAB 2: PREMIOS -->
<section id="tab-prizes" class="tab-panel">
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title"> Agregar premio al concurso</div>
<label for="prizeName">Nombre del premio</label>
<input id="prizeName" type="text" placeholder="Ej: Parlante JBL / Giftcard $50.000" />
<label for="prizeDesc">Detalle o auspiciador (opcional)</label>
<input id="prizeDesc" type="text" placeholder="Ej: Entregado por Tienda X" />
<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-transform:none;font-
size:14px;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:12px;">
<input id="prizeMajor" type="checkbox" style="width:auto;margin:0;" />
⭐ Marcar como Premio Mayor
</label>
<button class="btn btn-gold" onclick="addPrize()">➕ Agregar premio</button>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title"> Lista de premios (orden del sorteo)</div>
<p class="hint" style="margin-top:0;">Ordena de menor a Premio Mayor para mantener la
audiencia conectada en el Live.</p>
<div id="prizesList"></div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- TAB 3: SORTEO EN VIVO -->
<section id="tab-draw" class="tab-panel">
<div class="card hide-in-live">
<div class="card-title">
<span> Controles del Live</span>
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="toggleLiveFullscreen()"> Pantalla
Live</button>
</div>
<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:12px;">
<button id="btnSimToggle" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" style="flex:1;"
onclick="toggleSimMode()"> Simulacro: OFF</button>
<button id="btnSoundToggle" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" style="flex:1;"
onclick="toggleSound()"> Sonido: ON</button>
</div>
<label for="drawPrizeSelect">Premio a sortear ahora</label>
<select id="drawPrizeSelect" onchange="updateLiveStageHeader()"></select>
<div class="hint" style="margin-top:0;">Regla activa: <strong>Opción 1</strong> — cada
código gana una vez; quienes tienen más tickets siguen participando con sus códigos
restantes.</div>
</div>
<div id="liveStage" class="live-stage">
<div id="simRibbon" class="sim-ribbon hidden"> MODO SIMULACRO (ENSAYO) — NO
GUARDA GANADORES NI ALTERA DATOS</div>
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-
bottom:6px;">
<span class="live-badge" id="liveContestBadge">CONCURSO</span>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm hidden" id="liveSoundMini"
onclick="toggleSound()"></button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm hidden" id="exitLiveBtn"
onclick="toggleLiveFullscreen()">Salir Live</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="live-prize-name" id="livePrizeName">Agrega un premio para sortear</div>
<div class="roulette-box">
<div class="roulette-code" id="rouletteCode">CN-??????</div>
<div class="roulette-winner" id="rouletteWinner">Listo para girar</div>
<div class="roulette-rut" id="rouletteRut"></div>
</div>
<button class="btn btn-gold" id="btnStartDraw" onclick="startLiveDraw()"> SORTEAR
GANADOR</button>
</div>
<div class="card hide-in-live">
<div class="card-title"> Ganadores registrados</div>
<div id="winnersList"></div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- TAB 4: AJUSTES, PERSONALIZACIÓN, QR Y RESPALDOS -->
<section id="tab-settings" class="tab-panel">
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title">
<span> Verificar ticket o escanear QR</span>
<button class="btn btn-info btn-sm" onclick="openQrScanner()"> Escanear QR</button>
</div>
<div class="row">
<input id="verifyInput" type="text" placeholder="Código CN-... o ID S-..." style="margin-
bottom:0;text-transform:uppercase;" />
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="verifyCode()">Verificar</button>
</div>
<div id="verifyResult" style="margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title">
<span> Diseño del ticket PNG</span>
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="previewSampleTicket()"> Vista
previa</button>
</div>
<label>Tema de color</label>
<div class="theme-grid" id="themePicker"></div>
<label for="logoFileInput">Logo o foto del premio (opcional)</label>
<div id="logoPreviewWrap" class="logo-preview-wrap hidden">
<img id="logoPreviewThumb" alt="Logo del concurso" />
<div style="flex:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);" id="logoSizeInfo">Logo
cargado</div>
<button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="removeContestLogo()">Quitar</button>
</div>
<input id="logoFileInput" type="file" accept="image/*"
onchange="handleLogoUpload(event)" />
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title"> Respaldo y Cuadratura</div>
<p class="hint" style="margin-top:0;">Tus datos viven solo en este celular. Exporta tu
respaldo JSON al final del día y envíatelo a tu propio WhatsApp o Drive.</p>
<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:8px;">
<button class="btn btn-gold" onclick="exportContestJson()"> Respaldo JSON</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="exportContestCsv()"> Excel (CSV)</button>
</div>
<label for="importJsonFile" style="margin-top:10px;">Restaurar concurso desde archivo
JSON</label>
<input id="importJsonFile" type="file" accept=".json,application/json"
onchange="importContestJson(event)" />
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title"> Concursos</div>
<label for="contestSelector">Concurso activo</label>
<select id="contestSelector" onchange="switchContest(this.value)"></select>
<details style="margin-top:8px;">
<summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);font-
size:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">
➕ Crear nuevo concurso
</summary>
<label>Nombre del concurso</label>
<input id="newContestName" type="text" placeholder="Ej: Gran Concurso Diciembre" />
<label>Fecha del sorteo</label>
<input id="newContestDate" type="text" placeholder="Ej: 20 de Diciembre - 21:00 hrs" />
<label>Tu Instagram o WhatsApp (aparece en el ticket)</label>
<input id="newContestContact" type="text" placeholder="Ej: @tuinstagram / +569..." />
<label>Packs fijos (billetes redondos)</label>
<div class="row">
<input id="p1Qty" type="number" value="1" placeholder="Cant" />
<input id="p1Price" type="number" value="2000" placeholder="$" />
</div>
<div class="row">
<input id="p2Qty" type="number" value="3" placeholder="Cant" />
<input id="p2Price" type="number" value="5000" placeholder="$" />
</div>
<div class="row">
<input id="p3Qty" type="number" value="8" placeholder="Cant" />
<input id="p3Price" type="number" value="10000" placeholder="$" />
</div>
<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="createNewContest()">Crear concurso</button>
</details>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title"> Datos del concurso actual</div>
<label>Nombre</label>
<input id="editContestName" type="text" />
<label>Fecha del sorteo</label>
<input id="editContestDate" type="text" />
<label>Contacto / Red social en el ticket</label>
<input id="editContestContact" type="text" />
<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="saveCurrentContestMeta()">Guardar
cambios</button>
</div>
</section>
</main>
<!-- MODAL TICKET PNG -->
<div id="ticketModal" class="modal-backdrop">
<div class="modal">
<div class="card-title">
<span id="ticketModalTitle"> Ticket listo para enviar</span>
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="closeTicketModal()">✕</button>
</div>
<div id="ticketModalSummary" class="modal-pill hidden"></div>
<img id="ticketPreviewImg" class="ticket-preview" alt="Comprobante de participación" />
<div id="ticketModalActions" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">
<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="shareCurrentTicket()"> Enviar imagen por
WhatsApp</button>
<div class="row">
<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="openWhatsAppChat()"> Abrir chat
WA</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="downloadCurrentTicket()"> Guardar
PNG</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- MODAL ESCÁNER QR -->
<div id="qrScannerModal" class="modal-backdrop">
<div class="modal">

<script>
// ===================== TEMAS DE COLOR DEL TICKET =====================
const TICKET_THEMES = {

pillBorder: '#059669', pillText: '#047857', textMain: '#0f172a',
textMuted: '#475569', codeBg: '#f8fafc', codeText: '#0f172a', divider: '#cbd5e1'
}
};
// ===================== GENERADOR QR PURO (ISO 18004, EC-M, V1-V3)
=====================
const QR = (() => {
const EXP = new Uint8Array(512);
const LOG = new Uint8Array(256);
let v = 1;
for (let i = 0; i < 255; i++) {
EXP[i] = v; LOG[v] = i;
v <<= 1; if (v & 256) v ^= 0x11d;
}
for (let i = 255; i < 512; i++) EXP[i] = EXP[i - 255];
const gfMul = (a, b) => (a && b) ? EXP[LOG[a] + LOG[b]] : 0;
function rsEncode(data, ecCount) {
let gen = [1];
for (let i = 0; i < ecCount; i++) {
const next = new Array(gen.length + 1).fill(0);
for (let j = 0; j < gen.length; j++) {
next[j] ^= gen[j];
next[j + 1] ^= gfMul(gen[j], EXP[i]);
}
gen = next;
}
const rem = data.concat(new Array(ecCount).fill(0));
for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
const factor = rem[i];
if (factor) for (let j = 0; j < gen.length; j++) rem[i + j] ^= gfMul(gen[j], factor);
}
return rem.slice(data.length);
}
// EC Level M = 00
function getFormatBits(mask) {
let rem = mask << 10;
for (let i = 4; i >= 0; i--) if ((rem >> (i + 10)) & 1) rem ^= (0x537 << i);
return ((mask << 10) | rem) ^ 0x5412;
}
const MASKS = [
(r, c) => (r + c) % 2 === 0,
(r, c) => r % 2 === 0,
(r, c) => c % 3 === 0,
(r, c) => (r + c) % 3 === 0,
(r, c) => (Math.floor(r / 2) + Math.floor(c / 3)) % 2 === 0,
(r, c) => ((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3) === 0,
(r, c) => (((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0,
(r, c) => (((r + c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0
];
function generate(text) {
const bytes = Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(text)).slice(0, 42);
let ver, dataCap, ecCount, align;
if (bytes.length <= 14) { ver = 1; dataCap = 16; ecCount = 10; align = 0; }
else if (bytes.length <= 26) { ver = 2; dataCap = 28; ecCount = 16; align = 18; }
else { ver = 3; dataCap = 44; ecCount = 26; align = 22; }
const bits = [];
const pushBits = (val, len) => { for (let i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) bits.push((val >> i) & 1); };
pushBits(0b0100, 4);
pushBits(bytes.length, 8);
bytes.forEach((b) => pushBits(b, 8));
const maxBits = dataCap * 8;
pushBits(0, Math.min(4, maxBits - bits.length));
while (bits.length % 8 !== 0) bits.push(0);
const dataWords = [];
for (let i = 0; i < bits.length; i += 8) {
let byte = 0;
for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) byte = (byte << 1) | bits[i + j];
dataWords.push(byte);
}
const pads = [0xec, 0x11];
for (let i = 0; dataWords.length < dataCap; i++) dataWords.push(pads[i & 1]);
const allWords = dataWords.concat(rsEncode(dataWords, ecCount));
const size = 17 + ver * 4;
const base = Array.from({ length: size }, () => new Uint8Array(size));
const isFunc = Array.from({ length: size }, () => new Uint8Array(size));
[[0, 0], [0, size - 7], [size - 7, 0]].forEach(([r0, c0]) => {
for (let dr = -1; dr <= 7; dr++) {
for (let dc = -1; dc <= 7; dc++) {
const r = r0 + dr, c = c0 + dc;
if (r >= 0 && r < size && c >= 0 && c < size) {
isFunc[r][c] = 1;
const inBox = dr >= 0 && dr <= 6 && dc >= 0 && dc <= 6;
const dark = inBox && (dr === 0 || dr === 6 || dc === 0 || dc === 6 || (dr >= 2 && dr <=
4 && dc >= 2 && dc <= 4));
base[r][c] = dark ? 1 : 0;
}
}
}
});
if (align) {
for (let dr = -2; dr <= 2; dr++) {
for (let dc = -2; dc <= 2; dc++) {
isFunc[align + dr][align + dc] = 1;
base[align + dr][align + dc] = Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc)) !== 1 ? 1 : 0;
}
}
}
for (let i = 8; i < size - 8; i++) {
isFunc[6][i] = isFunc[i][6] = 1;
base[6][i] = base[i][6] = (i % 2 === 0) ? 1 : 0;
}
isFunc[size - 8][8] = 1;
base[size - 8][8] = 1;
const copy1 =
[[8,0],[8,1],[8,2],[8,3],[8,4],[8,5],[8,7],[8,8],[7,8],[5,8],[4,8],[3,8],[2,8],[1,8],[0,8]];
const copy2 = [[size-1,8],[size-2,8],[size-3,8],[size-4,8],[size-5,8],[size-6,8],[size-7,8],[8,size-
8],[8,size-7],[8,size-6],[8,size-5],[8,size-4],[8,size-3],[8,size-2],[8,size-1]];
copy1.concat(copy2).forEach(([r, c]) => { isFunc[r][c] = 1; });
let bitIdx = 0, up = true;
const totalBits = allWords.length * 8;
for (let right = size - 1; right >= 1; right -= 2) {
if (right === 6) right = 5;
for (let vert = 0; vert < size; vert++) {
const r = up ? (size - 1 - vert) : vert;
for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
const c = right - j;
if (!isFunc[r][c]) {
base[r][c] = bitIdx < totalBits ? ((allWords[bitIdx >> 3] >> (7 - (bitIdx & 7))) & 1) : 0;
bitIdx++;
}
}
}
up = !up;
}
let bestGrid = null, bestScore = Infinity;
for (let m = 0; m < 8; m++) {
const g = base.map((row) => row.slice());
const fn = MASKS[m];
for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) if (!isFunc[r][c] && fn(r, c)) g[r][c] ^= 1;
}
const fmt = getFormatBits(m);
for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
const b = (fmt >> (14 - i)) & 1;
g[copy1[i][0]][copy1[i][1]] = b;
g[copy2[i][0]][copy2[i][1]] = b;
}
let score = 0, dark = 0;
for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
let runR = 1, runC = 1;
for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
dark += g[r][c];
if (c > 0) {
if (g[r][c] === g[r][c - 1]) { runR++; if (runR === 5) score += 3; else if (runR > 5)
score++; } else runR = 1;
if (g[c][r] === g[c - 1][r]) { runC++; if (runC === 5) score += 3; else if (runC > 5)
score++; } else runC = 1;
}
if (r > 0 && c > 0 && g[r][c] === g[r-1][c] && g[r][c] === g[r][c-1] && g[r][c] === g[r-1][c-
1]) score += 3;
}
}
score += Math.abs(Math.round((dark * 100) / (size * size)) - 50) * 2;
if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestGrid = g; }
}
return bestGrid;
}
return { generate };
})();
// ===================== AUDIO SINTETIZADO (WEB AUDIO API)
=====================
let audioCtx = null;
let soundEnabled = localStorage.getItem('concursopro_sound') !== 'off';
function ensureAudio() {
if (!soundEnabled) return null;
const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
if (!AC) return null;
if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AC();
if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
return audioCtx;
}
function playTickSound(progress) {
const ctx = ensureAudio();
if (!ctx) return;
const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
const gain = ctx.createGain();
osc.type = 'triangle';
const freq = 340 + progress * 380;
osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(120, ctx.currentTime + 0.045);
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.14, ctx.currentTime);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.05);
osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.055);
}
function playWinFanfare() {
const ctx = ensureAudio();
if (!ctx) return;
const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5];
notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
const gain = ctx.createGain();
osc.type = 'sine';
const t = ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.11;
osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, t);
gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.22, t + 0.03);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + (idx === 3 ? 0.65 : 0.28));
osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
osc.start(t); osc.stop(t + (idx === 3 ? 0.68 : 0.3));
});
}
// ===================== ESTADO Y ALMACENAMIENTO LOCAL
=====================
const DB_NAME = 'ConcursoProDB';
const STORE_NAME = 'contests';
const LS_KEY = 'concursopro_fallback_v1';
let db = null;
let contests = [];
let activeContestId = localStorage.getItem('concursopro_active_id') || null;
let selectedPackIndex = 2;
let currentModalSale = null;
let currentTicketBlob = null;
let isDrawing = false;
let isSimMode = false;
let qrStream = null;
let qrScanTimer = null;
function openDB() {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
if (!window.indexedDB) return resolve(null);
const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
req.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
const idb = e.target.result;
if (!idb.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME))
idb.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
};
req.onsuccess = (e) => resolve(e.target.result);
req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
});
}
async function loadAllContests() {
if (db) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
const req = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).getAll();
req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
});
}
try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) || '[]'); } catch { return []; }
}
async function saveContest(contest) {
if (db) {
await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).put(contest);
tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = reject;
});
} else {
const idx = contests.findIndex((c) => c.id === contest.id);
if (idx >= 0) contests[idx] = contest; else contests.push(contest);
localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(contests));
}
}
function getActiveContest() {
const c = contests.find((x) => x.id === activeContestId) || contests[0];
if (c && !c.theme) c.theme = 'classic';
return c;
}
function createDefaultContest() {
return {
id: 'c_' + Date.now(),
name: 'Gran Concurso Oficial',
drawDate: 'Por definir',
contact: '@tuconcurso',
theme: 'classic',
logoDataUrl: '',
createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
unsavedChanges: 0,
packs: [
{ qty: 1, price: 2000, badge: '' },
{ qty: 3, price: 5000, badge: 'Ahorras $1.000' },
{ qty: 8, price: 10000, badge: ' Más elegido' }
],
prizes: [], sales: [], tickets: []
};
}
// ===================== UTILIDADES =====================
function escapeHtml(str) {
return String(str || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (m) => ({
'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;' }[m]));
}
const formatCLP = (n) => '$' + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('es-CL');
function showToast(msg) {
const el = document.getElementById('toast');
el.textContent = msg; el.style.display = 'block';
clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);
window._toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { el.style.display = 'none'; }, 2700);
}
const cleanRut = (val) => String(val || '').replace(/[^0-9kK]/g, '').toUpperCase();
function formatRut(val) {
const c = cleanRut(val);
if (c.length < 2) return c;
return c.slice(0, -1).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.') + '-' + c.slice(-1);
}
function validateRut(val) {
const c = cleanRut(val);
if (c.length < 7 || c.length > 9) return false;
const body = c.slice(0, -1), dv = c.slice(-1);
let sum = 0, mul = 2;
for (let i = body.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { sum += Number(body[i]) * mul; mul = mul === 7 ? 2 :
mul + 1; }
const rem = 11 - (sum % 11);
return dv === (rem === 11 ? '0' : rem === 10 ? 'K' : String(rem));
}
function maskRut(val) {
const f = formatRut(val);
if (f.includes('-') && f.length >= 6) {
const [body, dv] = f.split('-');
const digits = body.replace(/\./g, '');
if (digits.length >= 4) return digits.slice(0, 2) + '.XXX.XX' + digits.slice(-1) + '-' + dv;
}
return f ? f.slice(0, 2) + '***' + f.slice(-2) : 'Sin RUT';
}
function normalizePhone(val) {
let digits = String(val || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
if (digits.length === 9 && digits.startsWith('9')) digits = '56' + digits;
return digits;
}
function getCustomerStats(contest, rut) {
const target = cleanRut(rut);
if (!target) return { totalTickets: 0, lastSale: null };
const matchingSales = contest.sales.filter((s) => cleanRut(s.buyerRut) === target);
const totalTickets = contest.tickets.filter((t) => cleanRut(t.buyerRut) === target).length;
return { totalTickets, lastSale: matchingSales[0] || null };
}
const CODE_ALPHABET = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
function generateUniqueCode(existingSet) {
const bytes = new Uint8Array(6);
for (let tries = 0; tries < 50; tries++) {
crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
let code = 'CN-';
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) code += CODE_ALPHABET[bytes[i] & 31];
if (!existingSet.has(code)) { existingSet.add(code); return code; }
}
throw new Error('Error generando código');
}
function secureRandomInt(max) {
const limit = Math.floor(0x100000000 / max) * max;
const arr = new Uint32Array(1);
do { crypto.getRandomValues(arr); } while (arr[0] >= limit);
return arr[0] % max;
}
// ===================== NAVEGACIÓN Y RENDER =====================
function switchTab(tab) {
document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('active'));
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('active'));
document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).classList.add('active');
document.querySelector(`.nav-btn[data-tab="${tab}"]`).classList.add('active');
renderAll();
}
function renderAll() {
const c = getActiveContest();
if (!c) return;
document.getElementById('hdrContestName').textContent = c.name;
document.getElementById('hdrContestDate').textContent = 'Sorteo: ' + (c.drawDate || 'Por
definir');
document.getElementById('hdrRevenue').textContent = formatCLP(c.sales.reduce((s, x) =>
s + Number(x.amount || 0), 0));
const banner = document.getElementById('backupBanner');
if ((c.unsavedChanges || 0) > 0) {
banner.classList.remove('hidden');
document.getElementById('backupBannerText').textContent =
` ${c.unsavedChanges} cambio${c.unsavedChanges > 1 ? 's' : ''} sin respaldar`;
} else banner.classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('kpiSales').textContent = c.sales.length;
document.getElementById('kpiTickets').textContent = c.tickets.length;
document.getElementById('kpiPrizes').textContent = c.prizes.length;
renderPacks(c);
renderSalesList();
renderPrizesList(c);
renderDrawTab(c);
renderSettingsTab(c);
}
function renderPacks(c) {
document.getElementById('packsContainer').innerHTML = c.packs.map((p, idx) => {
const unit = Math.round(p.price / p.qty);
const isFeatured = idx === c.packs.length - 1;
return `
<button type="button" class="pack-btn ${idx === selectedPackIndex ? 'selected' : ''}
${isFeatured ? 'featured' : ''}" onclick="selectPack(${idx})">
${p.badge ? `<span class="pack-badge">${escapeHtml(p.badge)}</span>` : ''}
<span class="pack-qty">x${p.qty}</span>
<span class="pack-price">${formatCLP(p.price)}</span>
<span class="pack-unit">${formatCLP(unit)} c/u</span>
</button>`;
}).join('');
}
function selectPack(idx) { selectedPackIndex = idx; renderPacks(getActiveContest()); }
function onRutInput() {
const val = document.getElementById('buyerRut').value.trim();
const hint = document.getElementById('rutHint');
const retBox = document.getElementById('returningCustomerBox');
const c = getActiveContest();
if (!val) {
hint.className = 'hint';
hint.textContent = 'Verifica el abono real en tu banco antes de emitir.';
retBox.classList.add('hidden');
return;
}
if (validateRut(val)) {
hint.className = 'hint ok';
hint.textContent = '✓ RUT válido (' + formatRut(val) + ')';
} else {
hint.className = 'hint warn';
hint.textContent = ' Revisa el dígito verificador del RUT (igual puedes emitir si es
pasaporte).';
}
const stats = getCustomerStats(c, val);
if (stats.totalTickets > 0 && stats.lastSale) {
const needsAutofill = !document.getElementById('buyerName').value.trim() ||
!document.getElementById('buyerPhone').value.trim();
retBox.classList.remove('hidden');
retBox.innerHTML = `
<span>⭐ <strong>${escapeHtml(stats.lastSale.buyerName)}</strong> ya suma
<strong>${stats.totalTickets} ${stats.totalTickets === 1 ? 'ticket' : 'tickets'}</strong> en este
concurso.</span>
${needsAutofill ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-info btn-sm"
onclick="autofillReturning('${escapeHtml(stats.lastSale.id)}')">Usar datos</button>` : ''}`;
} else {
retBox.classList.add('hidden');
}
}
function autofillReturning(saleId) {
const s = getActiveContest().sales.find((x) => x.id === saleId);
if (!s) return;
document.getElementById('buyerName').value = s.buyerName;
if (s.buyerPhone) document.getElementById('buyerPhone').value = '+' + s.buyerPhone;
onRutInput();
showToast('Datos del cliente cargados');
}
// ===================== PLANTILLA Y PEGADO RÁPIDO =====================
function copySalesTemplate() {
const c = getActiveContest();
const lines = c.packs.map((p, i) =>
`${i === c.packs.length - 1 ? '' : ''} ${p.qty} ${p.qty === 1 ? 'ticket' : 'tickets'}:
${formatCLP(p.price)}${p.badge ? ' (' + p.badge + ')' : ''}`
).join('\n');
const msg =
`¡Hola! Para participar en *${c.name}* elige tu pack:\n${lines}\n\n` +
`✨ Mientras más tickets lleves, ¡más premios puedes ganar en el mismo sorteo!\n\n` +
`Envíame tu comprobante de transferencia junto a estos datos:\nNombre:\nRUT:\nPack:`;
navigator.clipboard?.writeText(msg)
.then(() => showToast('Plantilla copiada para WhatsApp'))
.catch(() => alert(msg));
}
function applyQuickPaste() {
const text = document.getElementById('quickPasteBox').value.trim();
if (!text) return showToast('Pega primero el texto del cliente');
const c = getActiveContest();
const lines = text.split(/\n+/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
let name = '', rut = '', phone = '', packIdx = -1;
for (const line of lines) {
const lower = line.toLowerCase();
if (/^nombre\s*[:\-]/i.test(line)) name = line.replace(/^nombre\s*[:\-]\s*/i, '').trim();
else if (/^rut\s*[:\-]/i.test(line)) rut = line.replace(/^rut\s*[:\-]\s*/i, '').trim();
else if (/^(whatsapp|fono|tel[eé]fono|cel)\s*[:\-]/i.test(line)) phone =
line.replace(/^(whatsapp|fono|tel[eé]fono|cel)\s*[:\-]\s*/i, '').trim();
else if (/^(pack|tickets?|cantidad|monto)\s*[:\-]/i.test(line)) {
const num = parseInt(line.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
packIdx = c.packs.findIndex((p) => p.qty === num || p.price === num);
} else if (!rut && /\b\d{1,2}\.?\d{3}\.?\d{3}-?[\dkK]\b/.test(line)) {
rut = line.match(/\b\d{1,2}\.?\d{3}\.?\d{3}-?[\dkK]\b/)[0];
} else if (!phone && /(\+?56)?\s*9[\s-]?\d{4}[\s-]?\d{4}/.test(line)) {
phone = line.match(/(\+?56)?\s*9[\s-]?\d{4}[\s-]?\d{4}/)[0];
} else if (packIdx < 0 && /\b(10\.?000|5\.?000|2\.?000|8|3|1)\b/.test(lower)) {
const num = parseInt(line.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
const found = c.packs.findIndex((p) => p.qty === num || p.price === num);
if (found >= 0) packIdx = found; else if (!name) name = line;
} else if (!name) name = line;
}
if (name) document.getElementById('buyerName').value = name;
if (phone) document.getElementById('buyerPhone').value = phone;
if (rut) { document.getElementById('buyerRut').value = formatRut(rut); onRutInput(); }
if (packIdx >= 0) selectPack(packIdx);
showToast('Datos cargados');
}
// ===================== VENTAS Y DETECCIÓN DE DUPLICADOS
=====================
async function createSale() {
const c = getActiveContest();
const name = document.getElementById('buyerName').value.trim();
const rawRut = document.getElementById('buyerRut').value.trim();
const phone = document.getElementById('buyerPhone').value.trim();
const pack = c.packs[selectedPackIndex];
if (!name) return showToast('Ingresa el nombre del comprador');
if (!rawRut) return showToast('Ingresa el RUT del comprador');
const cleaned = cleanRut(rawRut);
const fiveMinAgo = Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000;
const recentDup = c.sales.find((s) =>
cleanRut(s.buyerRut) === cleaned &&
Number(s.amount) === Number(pack.price) &&
new Date(s.createdAt).getTime() >= fiveMinAgo
);
if (recentDup) {
const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round((Date.now() - new
Date(recentDup.createdAt).getTime()) / 60000));
const ok = confirm(
` POSIBLE VENTA DUPLICADA\n\n` +
`${recentDup.buyerName} (${recentDup.buyerRut}) ya registró un pack de
${formatCLP(pack.price)} hace menos de ${mins} min.\n\n` +
`¿Confirmas que recibiste una SEGUNDA transferencia real en tu banco?`
);
if (!ok) return;
}
const rutFormatted = cleaned.length >= 7 ? formatRut(rawRut) : rawRut;
const existingCodes = new Set(c.tickets.map((t) => t.code));
const newCodes = [];
const saleId = 'S-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase();
for (let i = 0; i < pack.qty; i++) {
const code = generateUniqueCode(existingCodes);
newCodes.push(code);
c.tickets.push({
code, saleId, buyerName: name, buyerRut: rutFormatted,
buyerPhone: normalizePhone(phone), wonPrizeId: null
});
}
const sale = {
id: saleId, buyerName: name, buyerRut: rutFormatted,
buyerPhone: normalizePhone(phone), qty: pack.qty, amount: pack.price,
codes: newCodes, createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
};
c.sales.unshift(sale);
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
document.getElementById('buyerName').value = '';
document.getElementById('buyerRut').value = '';
document.getElementById('buyerPhone').value = '';
document.getElementById('quickPasteBox').value = '';
onRutInput();
renderAll();
openTicketModal(sale, false);
}
function renderSalesList() {
const c = getActiveContest();
const q = (document.getElementById('salesSearch').value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const filtered = c.sales.filter((s) =>
!q || s.buyerName.toLowerCase().includes(q) || s.buyerRut.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
s.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) || s.codes.some((cd) => cd.toLowerCase().includes(q))
);
document.getElementById('salesCountBadge').textContent = `${filtered.length} ventas`;
const container = document.getElementById('salesList');
if (!filtered.length) {
container.innerHTML = '<div class="hint" style="margin:6px 0 0;">Aún no hay ventas
registradas.</div>';
return;
}
container.innerHTML = filtered.slice(0, 40).map((s) => {
const dateStr = new Date(s.createdAt).toLocaleString('es-CL', { dateStyle: 'short',
timeStyle: 'short' });
const total = getCustomerStats(c, s.buyerRut).totalTickets;
return `
<div class="list-item" style="flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;">
<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;">
<div class="item-main">
<div class="item-title">${escapeHtml(s.buyerName)} · ${formatCLP(s.amount)}</div>
<div class="item-sub">${escapeHtml(s.buyerRut)} · Pack x${s.qty} (Acum: ${total}) ·
${dateStr}</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm"
onclick="openTicketById('${s.id}')"></button>
<button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteSale('${s.id}')"></button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="code-chips">${s.codes.map((cd) => `<span
class="chip">${escapeHtml(cd)}</span>`).join('')}</div>
</div>`;
}).join('');
}
async function deleteSale(saleId) {
const c = getActiveContest();
if (c.tickets.some((t) => t.saleId === saleId && t.wonPrizeId)) return showToast('No se
puede anular: ya ganó un premio');
if (!confirm('¿Anular esta venta y eliminar sus tickets?')) return;
c.sales = c.sales.filter((s) => s.id !== saleId);
c.tickets = c.tickets.filter((t) => t.saleId !== saleId);
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
renderAll();
showToast('Venta anulada');
}
// ===================== GENERADOR PNG (TEMAS + LOGO + QR REAL)
=====================
function drawRoundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); ctx.closePath();
}
function loadImageSafe(src) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
if (!src) return resolve(null);
const img = new Image();
img.onload = () => resolve(img);
img.onerror = () => resolve(null);
img.src = src;
});
}
async function renderTicketToBlob(contest, sale) {
const th = TICKET_THEMES[contest.theme] || TICKET_THEMES.classic;
const logoImg = await loadImageSafe(contest.logoDataUrl);
const W = 1080;
const cols = sale.codes.length === 1 ? 1 : 2;
const rows = Math.ceil(sale.codes.length / cols);
const gridH = rows * 112;
const logoSpace = logoImg ? 156 : 0;
const codesTitleY = 588 + logoSpace;
const codesStartY = codesTitleY + 34;
const qrBoxY = codesStartY + gridH + 28;
const H = qrBoxY + 236 + 78;
const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, H);
grad.addColorStop(0, th.bg1); grad.addColorStop(1, th.bg2);
ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
drawRoundRect(ctx, 42, 42, W - 84, H - 84, 36);
ctx.fillStyle = th.card; ctx.fill();
ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.strokeStyle = th.border; ctx.stroke();
let y = 122;
if (logoImg) {
const maxW = 360, maxH = 128;
const scale = Math.min(maxW / logoImg.width, maxH / logoImg.height, 1);
const dw = Math.round(logoImg.width * scale);
const dh = Math.round(logoImg.height * scale);
const dx = Math.round((W - dw) / 2);
const dy = Math.round(80 + (maxH - dh) / 2);
ctx.save();
drawRoundRect(ctx, dx, dy, dw, dh, 18);
ctx.clip();
ctx.drawImage(logoImg, dx, dy, dw, dh);
ctx.restore();
y = 122 + logoSpace;
}
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillStyle = th.accent;
ctx.font = '800 26px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('COMPROBANTE OFICIAL DE PARTICIPACIÓN', W / 2, y);
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMain;
ctx.font = '900 52px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(contest.name.slice(0, 28), W / 2, y + 68);
const pillText = `PACK x${sale.qty} ${sale.qty === 1 ? 'TICKET' : 'TICKETS'} ·
${formatCLP(sale.amount)}`;
drawRoundRect(ctx, W / 2 - 270, y + 102, 540, 62, 31);
ctx.fillStyle = th.pillBg; ctx.fill();
ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = th.pillBorder; ctx.stroke();
ctx.fillStyle = th.pillText;
ctx.font = '800 29px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(pillText, W / 2, y + 143);
const infoY = y + 196;
drawRoundRect(ctx, 90, infoY, W - 180, 174, 22);
ctx.fillStyle = th.inner; ctx.fill();
ctx.textAlign = 'left';
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMuted;
ctx.font = '700 23px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('PARTICIPANTE', 130, infoY + 48);
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMain;
ctx.font = '800 39px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(sale.buyerName.slice(0, 30), 130, infoY + 98);
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMuted;
ctx.font = '600 25px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
const fecha = new Date(sale.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('es-CL');
ctx.fillText(`RUT: ${maskRut(sale.buyerRut)} • Emitido: ${fecha}`, 130, infoY + 144);
const divY = infoY + 214;
ctx.strokeStyle = th.divider; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.setLineDash([16, 14]);
ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(90, divY); ctx.lineTo(W - 90, divY); ctx.stroke();
ctx.setLineDash([]);
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMuted;
ctx.font = '800 27px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(sale.codes.length === 1 ? 'TU CÓDIGO DE SORTEO' : 'TUS CÓDIGOS DE
SORTEO', W / 2, codesTitleY);
const cardW = cols === 1 ? 620 : 426;
const cardH = 88;
const gapX = 36;
const startX = cols === 1 ? (W - cardW) / 2 : (W - (cardW * 2 + gapX)) / 2;
sale.codes.forEach((code, idx) => {
const r = Math.floor(idx / cols), col = idx % cols;
const cx = startX + col * (cardW + gapX);
const cy = codesStartY + r * 112;
drawRoundRect(ctx, cx, cy, cardW, cardH, 16);
ctx.fillStyle = th.codeBg; ctx.fill();
ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.strokeStyle = th.border; ctx.stroke();
ctx.fillStyle = th.codeText;
ctx.font = '900 39px ui-monospace, Roboto Mono, monospace';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText(code, cx + cardW / 2, cy + 58);
});
drawRoundRect(ctx, 90, qrBoxY, W - 180, 236, 22);
ctx.fillStyle = th.inner; ctx.fill();
const qrPayload = 'CP:' + sale.id;
const matrix = QR.generate(qrPayload);
const qSize = matrix.length;
const boxPx = 196;
const cell = Math.floor(boxPx / (qSize + 8));
const drawPx = cell * qSize;
const qrBoxX = 112, qrBoxTop = qrBoxY + 20;
drawRoundRect(ctx, qrBoxX, qrBoxTop, boxPx, boxPx, 14);
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.fill();
const offsetX = qrBoxX + Math.floor((boxPx - drawPx) / 2);
const offsetY = qrBoxTop + Math.floor((boxPx - drawPx) / 2);
ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
for (let r = 0; r < qSize; r++) {
for (let c = 0; c < qSize; c++) {
if (matrix[r][c]) ctx.fillRect(offsetX + c * cell, offsetY + r * cell, cell, cell);
}
}
const tx = 336;
ctx.textAlign = 'left';
ctx.fillStyle = th.accent;
ctx.font = '800 25px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(` Sorteo: ${(contest.drawDate || 'Por definir').slice(0, 32)}`, tx, qrBoxY + 62);
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMain;
ctx.font = '700 24px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('Cada código es una opción real.', tx, qrBoxY + 108);
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMuted;
ctx.font = '600 22px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('¡Aumenta tus opciones antes del cierre!', tx, qrBoxY + 142);
ctx.fillStyle = th.pillText;
ctx.font = '800 24px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif';
ctx.fillText((contest.contact || 'ConcursoPro').slice(0, 32), tx, qrBoxY + 186);
ctx.fillStyle = th.textMuted;
ctx.font = '700 20px ui-monospace, Roboto Mono, monospace';
ctx.fillText(`ID VERIFICABLE: ${sale.id}`, tx, qrBoxY + 218);
return new Promise((resolve) => canvas.toBlob((blob) => resolve(blob), 'image/png'));
}
function openTicketById(saleId) {
const sale = getActiveContest().sales.find((s) => s.id === saleId);
if (sale) openTicketModal(sale, false);
}
async function previewSampleTicket() {

const pack = c.packs[c.packs.length - 1] || { qty: 3, price: 5000 };
const sample = {
id: 'S-MUESTRA01', buyerName: 'Camila Rojas (Ejemplo)', buyerRut: '18.456.789-2',
buyerPhone: '', qty: pack.qty, amount: pack.price,
codes: Array.from({ length: pack.qty }, (_, i) => `CN-EJEM0${i + 1}`),
createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
};

async function openTicketModal(sale, isSample) {
const c = getActiveContest();
currentModalSale = isSample ? null : sale;
currentTicketBlob = await renderTicketToBlob(c, sale);
const url = URL.createObjectURL(currentTicketBlob);
const img = document.getElementById('ticketPreviewImg');
if (img.dataset.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(img.dataset.url);
img.src = url; img.dataset.url = url;
document.getElementById('ticketModalTitle').textContent = isSample ? ' Vista previa del
diseño' : ' Ticket listo para enviar';
document.getElementById('ticketModalActions').classList.toggle('hidden', isSample);
const sumEl = document.getElementById('ticketModalSummary');
if (!isSample) {
const total = getCustomerStats(c, sale.buyerRut).totalTickets;
sumEl.classList.remove('hidden');
sumEl.textContent = total > sale.qty
? ` ¡Cliente recurrente! Con esta compra acumula ${total} tickets en total.`
: `✅ Emitido: ${sale.qty} ${sale.qty === 1 ? 'ticket' : 'tickets'} · QR verificable incluido.`;
} else sumEl.classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('ticketModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeTicketModal() {
document.getElementById('ticketModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function buildWhatsAppText(contest, sale) {
const total = getCustomerStats(contest, sale.buyerRut).totalTickets;
const accumLine = total > sale.qty
? `\n ¡Ya acumulas *${total} códigos en total* participando por los premios!`
: '';
return `¡Gracias por participar en *${contest.name}*, ${sale.buyerName}! ✅\n` +
`Aquí tienes tu comprobante con ${sale.qty} ${sale.qty === 1 ? 'código' :
'códigos'}.${accumLine}\n¡Mucho éxito en el sorteo! `;
}
async function shareCurrentTicket() {
if (!currentTicketBlob || !currentModalSale) return;
const c = getActiveContest();
const file = new File([currentTicketBlob], `ticket-${currentModalSale.id}.png`, { type:
'image/png' });
const text = buildWhatsAppText(c, currentModalSale);
if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
try { await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: c.name, text }); return; }
catch (err) { if (err.name === 'AbortError') return; }
}
downloadCurrentTicket();
showToast('Imagen guardada; adjúntala en WhatsApp');
}
function downloadCurrentTicket() {
if (!currentTicketBlob || !currentModalSale) return;
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(currentTicketBlob);
a.download = `ticket-${currentModalSale.buyerName.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}-
${currentModalSale.id}.png`;
a.click();
showToast('Ticket PNG guardado');
}
function openWhatsAppChat() {
if (!currentModalSale) return;
const c = getActiveContest();
const msg = encodeURIComponent(
buildWhatsAppText(c, currentModalSale) + `\n\nTus códigos:
${currentModalSale.codes.join(', ')}`
);
window.open(currentModalSale.buyerPhone ?
`https://wa.me/${currentModalSale.buyerPhone}?text=${msg}` : `https://wa.me/?text=${msg}`,
'_blank');
}

async function addPrize() {
const name = document.getElementById('prizeName').value.trim();
const desc = document.getElementById('prizeDesc').value.trim();
const isMajor = document.getElementById('prizeMajor').checked;
if (!name) return showToast('Escribe el nombre del premio');
const c = getActiveContest();
c.prizes.push({ id: 'P-' + Date.now().toString(36), name, desc, isMajor, winner: null });
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
document.getElementById('prizeName').value = '';
document.getElementById('prizeDesc').value = '';
document.getElementById('prizeMajor').checked = false;
renderAll(); showToast('Premio agregado');
}
function renderPrizesList(c) {
const el = document.getElementById('prizesList');
if (!c.prizes.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="hint" style="margin:0;">Aún no hay
premios. Agrega los que vayan llegando.</div>'; return; }
el.innerHTML = c.prizes.map((p, idx) => `
<div class="list-item">
<div class="item-main">
<div class="item-title">${p.isMajor ? '⭐ ' : ''}${idx + 1}. ${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div>
<div class="item-sub">${p.desc ? escapeHtml(p.desc) + ' · ' : ''}${p.winner ? `
Ganador: ${escapeHtml(p.winner.buyerName)} (${escapeHtml(p.winner.code)})` : 'Pendiente
por sortear'}</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;">
${idx > 0 ? `<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="movePrize(${idx}, -
1)">↑</button>` : ''}
${idx < c.prizes.length - 1 ? `<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm"
onclick="movePrize(${idx}, 1)">↓</button>` : ''}
${!p.winner ? `<button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm"
onclick="deletePrize('${p.id}')"></button>` : ''}
</div>
</div>`).join('');
}
async function movePrize(idx, delta) {
const c = getActiveContest(), target = idx + delta;
if (target < 0 || target >= c.prizes.length) return;
[c.prizes[idx], c.prizes[target]] = [c.prizes[target], c.prizes[idx]];
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c); renderAll();
}
async function deletePrize(id) {
if (!confirm('¿Eliminar este premio?')) return;
const c = getActiveContest();
c.prizes = c.prizes.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c); renderAll();
}

function toggleLiveFullscreen() {

function startLiveDraw() {
if (isDrawing) return;
ensureAudio();
const c = getActiveContest();
const pid = document.getElementById('drawPrizeSelect').value;
const prize = c.prizes.find((p) => p.id === pid && !p.winner);
if (!isSimMode && !prize) return showToast('Agrega o selecciona un premio pendiente');
let activePool = c.tickets.filter((t) => !t.wonPrizeId);
if (!activePool.length) {
if (!isSimMode) return showToast('No hay tickets activos para sortear');
activePool = [
{ code: 'CN-PRB9A2', buyerName: 'Camila Prueba', buyerRut: '18.234.567-K' },
{ code: 'CN-PRB4K7', buyerName: 'Matías Ensayo', buyerRut: '19.876.543-2' },
{ code: 'CN-PRB7M3', buyerName: 'Sofía Demo', buyerRut: '17.444.333-5' },
{ code: 'CN-PRB2X9', buyerName: 'Diego Test', buyerRut: '20.111.222-8' }
];
}
isDrawing = true;
const btn = document.getElementById('btnStartDraw');
btn.disabled = true;
btn.textContent = isSimMode ? ' ENSAYANDO...' : '✨ SORTEANDO...';
const winnerTicket = activePool[secureRandomInt(activePool.length)];
const codeEl = document.getElementById('rouletteCode');
const winEl = document.getElementById('rouletteWinner');
const rutEl = document.getElementById('rouletteRut');
winEl.textContent = 'Buscando ganador...';
rutEl.textContent = '';
let step = 0, totalSteps = 34;
function tick() {
step++;
if (step < totalSteps) {
codeEl.textContent = activePool[secureRandomInt(activePool.length)].code;
playTickSound(step / totalSteps);
setTimeout(tick, 45 + Math.pow(step / totalSteps, 2.6) * 310);
} else {
finalizeWinner(c, prize, winnerTicket);
}
}
tick();
}
async function finalizeWinner(c, prize, ticket) {
if (!isSimMode && prize) {
ticket.wonPrizeId = prize.id;
prize.winner = {
code: ticket.code, buyerName: ticket.buyerName, buyerRut: ticket.buyerRut,
buyerPhone: ticket.buyerPhone, drawnAt: new Date().toISOString()
};
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
}
document.getElementById('rouletteCode').textContent = ticket.code;
document.getElementById('rouletteWinner').textContent = (isSimMode ? ' ' : ' ') +
ticket.buyerName;
document.getElementById('rouletteRut').textContent = isSimMode
? 'SIMULACRO — No guardado en el concurso'
: 'RUT: ' + maskRut(ticket.buyerRut);
playWinFanfare();
launchConfetti();
isDrawing = false;
const btn = document.getElementById('btnStartDraw');
btn.disabled = false;
btn.textContent = isSimMode ? ' PROBAR OTRO SIMULACRO' : ' SORTEAR
SIGUIENTE PREMIO';
renderAll();
}
function contactWinner(prizeId) {
const c = getActiveContest(), p = c.prizes.find((x) => x.id === prizeId);
if (!p || !p.winner) return;
const msg = encodeURIComponent(
` ¡FELICIDADES ${p.winner.buyerName}! Ganaste *${p.name}* en *${c.name}* con tu
código *${p.winner.code}*. ¡Coordinemos la entrega!`
);
window.open(`https://wa.me/${p.winner.buyerPhone}?text=${msg}`, '_blank');
}
function launchConfetti() {
const canvas = document.getElementById('confettiCanvas');
canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
canvas.style.display = 'block';
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const colors = ['#f59e0b', '#10b981', '#38bdf8', '#f43f5e', '#fef08a'];
const pieces = Array.from({ length: 110 }, () => ({
x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: -20 - Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.4,
w: 7 + Math.random() * 6, h: 10 + Math.random() * 8,
vy: 3 + Math.random() * 5, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, vrot: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)]
}));
let frames = 0;
(function frame() {
ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
for (const p of pieces) {
p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.rot += p.vrot;
ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(p.rot);
ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.fillRect(-p.w / 2, -p.h / 2, p.w, p.h);
ctx.restore();
}
if (++frames < 140) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else canvas.style.display = 'none';
})();
}
// ===================== PERSONALIZACIÓN (LOGO Y TEMA)
=====================
async function selectTheme(themeKey) {
const c = getActiveContest();
c.theme = themeKey;
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
renderAll();
showToast('Tema actualizado: ' + TICKET_THEMES[themeKey].name);
}
function handleLogoUpload(e) {
const file = e.target.files[0];
if (!file) return;
const reader = new FileReader();
reader.onload = () => {
const img = new Image();
img.onload = async () => {
const maxDim = 320;
const scale = Math.min(maxDim / img.width, maxDim / img.height, 1);
const cw = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width * scale));
const ch = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));
const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
cv.width = cw; cv.height = ch;
cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, cw, ch);
let dataUrl = cv.toDataURL('image/png');
if (dataUrl.length > 180000) dataUrl = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82);
if (dataUrl.length > 180000) dataUrl = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.65);
const c = getActiveContest();
c.logoDataUrl = dataUrl;
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
renderAll();
showToast('Logo guardado (' + Math.round(dataUrl.length / 1024) + ' KB)');
};
img.src = reader.result;
};
reader.readAsDataURL(file);
e.target.value = '';
}
async function removeContestLogo() {
const c = getActiveContest();
c.logoDataUrl = '';
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c);
renderAll();
showToast('Logo eliminado');
}
// ===================== VERIFICADOR Y ESCÁNER QR =====================
function verifyCode(overrideVal) {
const c = getActiveContest();
const raw = (overrideVal !== undefined ? overrideVal :
document.getElementById('verifyInput').value).trim().toUpperCase();
if (overrideVal !== undefined) document.getElementById('verifyInput').value = raw;
const box = document.getElementById('verifyResult');
if (!raw) return;
const saleKey = raw.startsWith('CP:') ? raw.slice(3) : raw;
const sale = c.sales.find((s) => s.id.toUpperCase() === saleKey);
if (sale) {
const total = getCustomerStats(c, sale.buyerRut).totalTickets;
const saleTickets = c.tickets.filter((t) => t.saleId === sale.id);
box.innerHTML = `
<div style="background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--primary);padding:11px;border-
radius:10px;">
<div style="color:var(--primary);font-weight:800;">✅ COMPROBANTE VÁLIDO
(${escapeHtml(sale.id)})</div>
<div>Titular: <strong>${escapeHtml(sale.buyerName)}</strong>
(${escapeHtml(sale.buyerRut)})</div>
<div>Pack x${sale.qty} (${formatCLP(sale.amount)}) · Total cliente: <strong>${total}
tickets</strong></div>
<div class="code-chips">
${saleTickets.map((t) => {
const wp = t.wonPrizeId ? c.prizes.find((p) => p.id === t.wonPrizeId) : null;
return `<span class="chip ${wp ? 'winner' : ''}">${escapeHtml(t.code)}${wp ? ' ' :
''}</span>`;
}).join('')}
</div>
</div>`;
return;
}
const t = c.tickets.find((x) => x.code.toUpperCase() === raw);
if (!t) {
box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#fca5a5;font-weight:700;">❌ "${escapeHtml(raw)}"
no existe en este concurso.</span>`;
return;
}
const wonPrize = t.wonPrizeId ? c.prizes.find((p) => p.id === t.wonPrizeId) : null;
const total = getCustomerStats(c, t.buyerRut).totalTickets;
box.innerHTML = `
<div style="background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--primary);padding:11px;border-
radius:10px;">
<div style="color:var(--primary);font-weight:800;">✅ CÓDIGO VÁLIDO:
${escapeHtml(t.code)}</div>
<div>Titular: <strong>${escapeHtml(t.buyerName)}</strong>
(${escapeHtml(t.buyerRut)})</div>
<div>Total acumulado del cliente: <strong>${total} ${total === 1 ? 'ticket' :
'tickets'}</strong></div>
<div>Estado: ${wonPrize ? ` Ya ganó "${escapeHtml(wonPrize.name)}"` : ' Activo
participando'}</div>
</div>`;
}
async function openQrScanner() {
const modal = document.getElementById('qrScannerModal');
const status = document.getElementById('qrScannerStatus');
const video = document.getElementById('qrVideo');
modal.classList.add('open');
if (!('BarcodeDetector' in window)) {
status.textContent = 'Tu navegador no soporta escaneo QR directo. Escribe el código CN-
... o ID S-... manualmente.';
return;
}
if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
status.textContent = 'No se puede acceder a la cámara en este contexto (requiere
HTTPS). Usa el ingreso manual.';
return;
}
try {
status.textContent = 'Iniciando cámara trasera...';
qrStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode:
'environment' } });
video.srcObject = qrStream;
await video.play();
status.textContent = 'Apunta al código QR del ticket...';
const detector = new BarcodeDetector({ formats: ['qr_code'] });
qrScanTimer = setInterval(async () => {
if (!video || video.readyState < 2) return;
try {
const found = await detector.detect(video);
if (found.length && found[0].rawValue) {
const val = found[0].rawValue.trim();
navigator.vibrate?.(80);
closeQrScanner();
verifyCode(val);
showToast('QR reconocido');
}
} catch {}
}, 220);
} catch {
status.textContent = 'Permiso de cámara denegado o no disponible. Ingresa el código
manualmente.';
}
}
function closeQrScanner() {
if (qrScanTimer) { clearInterval(qrScanTimer); qrScanTimer = null; }
if (qrStream) { qrStream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop()); qrStream = null; }
const video = document.getElementById('qrVideo');
if (video) video.srcObject = null;
document.getElementById('qrScannerModal').classList.remove('open');
}
// ===================== AJUSTES Y RESPALDOS =====================
function renderSettingsTab(c) {
document.getElementById('contestSelector').innerHTML = contests.map((x) =>
`<option value="${x.id}" ${x.id === c.id ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(x.name)}
(${x.tickets.length} tickets)</option>`
).join('');
document.getElementById('editContestName').value = c.name;
document.getElementById('editContestDate').value = c.drawDate || '';
document.getElementById('editContestContact').value = c.contact || '';
document.getElementById('themePicker').innerHTML =
Object.entries(TICKET_THEMES).map(([key, th]) => `
<button type="button" class="theme-opt ${(c.theme || 'classic') === key ? 'active' : ''}"
onclick="selectTheme('${key}')">
<span class="swatch" style="background:${th.swatch};"></span>
<span>${escapeHtml(th.name)}</span>
</button>`).join('');
const wrap = document.getElementById('logoPreviewWrap');
if (c.logoDataUrl) {
wrap.classList.remove('hidden');
document.getElementById('logoPreviewThumb').src = c.logoDataUrl;
document.getElementById('logoSizeInfo').textContent = `Logo activo
(${Math.round(c.logoDataUrl.length / 1024)} KB)`;
} else wrap.classList.add('hidden');
}
function switchContest(id) {
activeContestId = id;
localStorage.setItem('concursopro_active_id', id);
selectedPackIndex = Math.min(2, getActiveContest().packs.length - 1);
renderAll();
}
async function createNewContest() {
const name = document.getElementById('newContestName').value.trim();
if (!name) return showToast('Ponle un nombre al concurso');
const packs = [
{ qty: parseInt(document.getElementById('p1Qty').value, 10) || 1, price:
parseInt(document.getElementById('p1Price').value, 10) || 2000, badge: '' },
{ qty: parseInt(document.getElementById('p2Qty').value, 10) || 3, price:
parseInt(document.getElementById('p2Price').value, 10) || 5000, badge: 'Pack Ahorro' },
{ qty: parseInt(document.getElementById('p3Qty').value, 10) || 8, price:
parseInt(document.getElementById('p3Price').value, 10) || 10000, badge: ' Más elegido' }
];
const nc = {
id: 'c_' + Date.now(), name,
drawDate: document.getElementById('newContestDate').value.trim() || 'Por definir',
contact: document.getElementById('newContestContact').value.trim() || '',
theme: 'classic', logoDataUrl: '', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
unsavedChanges: 0, packs, prizes: [], sales: [], tickets: []
};
contests.push(nc); await saveContest(nc);
activeContestId = nc.id; localStorage.setItem('concursopro_active_id', nc.id);
document.getElementById('newContestName').value = '';
renderAll(); showToast('Nuevo concurso creado');
}
async function saveCurrentContestMeta() {
const c = getActiveContest();
c.name = document.getElementById('editContestName').value.trim() || c.name;
c.drawDate = document.getElementById('editContestDate').value.trim();
c.contact = document.getElementById('editContestContact').value.trim();
c.unsavedChanges = (c.unsavedChanges || 0) + 1;
await saveContest(c); renderAll(); showToast('Datos actualizados');
}
async function exportContestJson() {
const c = getActiveContest();
const copy = { ...c, unsavedChanges: 0, exportedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(copy, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
const filename = `respaldo-${c.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')}-${new
Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
const file = new File([blob], filename, { type: 'application/json' });
if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
try { await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Respaldo ' + c.name }); }
catch (err) { if (err.name === 'AbortError') return; }
} else {
const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download
= filename; a.click();
}
c.unsavedChanges = 0; await saveContest(c); renderAll(); showToast('Respaldo generado');
}
function exportContestCsv() {
const c = getActiveContest();
const header = ['Fecha', 'ID Venta', 'Nombre', 'RUT', 'WhatsApp', 'Pack', 'Monto CLP',
'Codigos'];
const rows = c.sales.map((s) => [
new Date(s.createdAt).toLocaleString('es-CL'), s.id, s.buyerName, s.buyerRut,
s.buyerPhone, 'x' + s.qty, s.amount, s.codes.join(' | ')
].map((v) => `"${String(v || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(','));
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\uFEFF' + [header.join(','), ...rows].join('\n')], {
type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' }));
a.download = `ventas-${c.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')}.csv`;
a.click(); showToast('Excel (CSV) descargado');
}
async function importContestJson(e) {
const file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
try {
const data = JSON.parse(await file.text());
if (!data.id || !data.name || !Array.isArray(data.tickets)) return showToast('Archivo de
respaldo no válido');
if (!data.theme) data.theme = 'classic';
data.unsavedChanges = 0;
const idx = contests.findIndex((x) => x.id === data.id);
if (idx >= 0) contests[idx] = data; else contests.push(data);
await saveContest(data);
activeContestId = data.id; localStorage.setItem('concursopro_active_id', data.id);
renderAll(); showToast('Concurso restaurado con éxito');
} catch { showToast('Error al leer el archivo JSON'); }
e.target.value = '';
}
// ===================== INICIALIZACIÓN =====================
(async function init() {
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').catch(() => {});
if (navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) navigator.storage.persist().catch(() => {});
db = await openDB();
contests = await loadAllContests();
if (!contests.length) {
const def = createDefaultContest();
contests.push(def); await saveContest(def);
}
if (!activeContestId || !contests.some((c) => c.id === activeContestId)) activeContestId =
contests[0].id;
renderAll();
})();
</script>
</body>
